Talia: @here lunchtime micro-challenge tomorrow: Urban Agility Relay (courtyard obstacles) vs Silent Desk Yoga (guided 15-min). Loser brings ice cream :icecream:
Ethan: Urban Agility for me. low-key obstacles = hopscotch + cone weave?
Rosa: Desk yoga pls. my neck is murdered.
Mika: Relay sounds wild. Can we make it 'no phone' rule for relay? :thinking:
Hannah: Ill DJ the silence for yoga (set volume to zero). :smile:
Talia: Signup: `@name - pick - meetup - notes`
Ethan: `@Ethan - relay - courtyard - lace trainers`
Rosa: `@Rosa - yoga - conference B - will bring mat`
Mika: `@Mika - relay - courtyard - down for cones`
Hannah: `@Hannah - yoga - conf B - will lead breathing + neck stretches`
Talia: Facilities said courtyard ok + yoga in conf B. Weather looks fine.
Mika: Proposal: relay teams add 5s penalty per dropped baton (we're using a plush dino). Agree?
Ethan: :thumbsup: plush baton = morale booster
FitBot: Reminder set \u2014 "Urban Agility Relay vs Silent Desk Yoga" tomorrow 12:15. React with :bell: to confirm.
Rosa: :bell:
Hannah: :bell: see you all, and Ill bring a spare sweater for yoga.
Ethan: Also tiny variant: loser sings 30s chorus at next team lunch. Fair?
Rosa: Deal. Might be off-key. :)
Talia: Great  looks like 2 relay / 3 yoga so yoga might win. If <3 relay we convert to solo obstacle times.
Mika: Cool. Whoever loses buys tubs of oat-milk ice cream. May the calmest breathe win.
